labels.executed_by_candidate: check authored and run by the candidate via the admitted isolated Python executor; receipts recorded by the executor
labels.proposed_unexecuted: designed but not run in this stage; no receipt exists

meta.scope_warning: Every executed witness below is an isolated component check (pure stdlib reference behavior). None establishes full-application behavior, GUI behavior, or third-party library behavior.

witnesses.label: executed by candidate
witnesses.title: Stored-coordinate precision: JSON binary64 round-trip vs float32 coercion
witnesses.claim_tested: Float64 coordinates serialized as JSON text round-trip exactly; float32 coercion is lossy (~1e-8 relative), so stored coordinates/calibration must be binary64 + round-trippable decimal text.
witnesses.expected_and_why: Python float repr/parse uses shortest round-trip decimals, so json.loads(json.dumps(x)) == x for finite doubles; struct float32 keeps ~7 significant digits, so relative errors ~1e-8..4e-8 appear. (IEEE-754 binary64 round-trip needs up to 17 significant decimal digits — standard behavior, exercised here rather than cited.)
witnesses.limits: Validates only the stdlib json/struct reference path in the isolated executor (no network, 256 MiB, 5 s wall). Does not validate other JSON writers/parsers, disk-level corruption, or any application's persistence code.

witnesses.label: executed by candidate
witnesses.title: Affine contract algebra: compose (voxel->physical)->(physical->display) and invert
witnesses.claim_tested: Storing voxel->physical (scale+translation) and deriving physical->display at runtime yields a composed mapping whose inverse recovers voxel coordinates to float64 round-off; display changes cannot silently alter stored coordinates.
witnesses.expected_and_why: Affine maps compose associatively and are invertible for nonzero determinant; pure-Python 2D reference must agree to near machine epsilon.
witnesses.limits: Pure-Python 2D affine reference only: no GPU path, no 3D/affine-with-rotation case, no resampling, no application code. Establishes contract math, not viewer behavior.

witnesses.label: executed by candidate
witnesses.title: Save-integrity mechanics: temp file + os.replace; aborted save leaves previous target
witnesses.claim_tested: The temp-then-rename save mechanism replaces the target wholesale (temp consumed), and an abort before rename leaves the previous manifest intact and loadable.
witnesses.input: project.json / project.json.tmp in the executor's fresh filesystem; staged write/replace/abort sequence
witnesses.expected_and_why: POSIX rename(2) semantics: rename removes the source name and replaces the target atomically with respect to concurrent openers; a writer that never reaches rename leaves the old target.
witnesses.limits: Mechanics only. No crash injection (SIGKILL mid-write), no fsync/durability test, no power-loss simulation, no cross-filesystem rename case. Full recovery behavior is P2 (proposed, UNEXECUTED).
